kurals.tr: Suzhandrumerp Pinnadhu Ulakam Adhanaal / Uzhandhum Uzhave Thalai
kurals.m: Agriculture, though laborious, is the most excellent (form of labour); for people, though they go about (in search of various employments), have at last to resort to the farmer

kurals.tr: Uzhuvaar Ulakaththaarkku Aaniaq Thaatraadhu / Ezhuvaarai Ellaam Poruththu
kurals.m: Agriculturists are (as it were) the linch-pin of the world for they support all other workers who cannot till the soil

kurals.tr: Uzhudhuntu Vaazhvaare Vaazhvaarmar Rellaam / Thozhudhuntu Pinsel Pavar
kurals.m: They alone live who live by agriculture; all others lead a cringing, dependent life

kurals.tr: Palakutai Neezhalum Thangutaikkeezhk Kaanpar / Alakutai Neezha Lavar
kurals.m: Patriotic farmers desire to bring all other states under the control of their own king

kurals.tr: Iravaar Irappaarkkondru Eevar Karavaadhu / Kaiseydhoon Maalai Yavar
kurals.m: Those whose nature is to live by manual labour will never beg but give something to those who beg

kurals.tr: Uzhavinaar Kaimmatangin Illai Vizhaivadhooum / Vittemen Paarkkum Nilai
kurals.m: If the farmer's hands are slackened, even the ascetic state will fail

kurals.tr: Thotippuzhudhi Kaqsaa Unakkin Pitiththeruvum / Ventaadhu Saalap Patum
kurals.m: If the land is dried so as to reduce one ounce of earth to a quarter, it will grow plentifully even without a handful of manure

kurals.tr: Erinum Nandraal Eruvitudhal Kattapin / Neerinum Nandradhan Kaappu
kurals.m: Manuring is better than ploughing; after weeding, watching is better than watering (it)

kurals.tr: Sellaan Kizhavan Iruppin Nilampulandhu / Illaalin Ooti Vitum
kurals.m: If the owner does not (personally) attend to his cultivation, his land will behave like an angry wife and yield him no pleasure

kurals.tr: Ilamendru Asaii Iruppaaraik Kaanin / Nilamennum Nallaal Nakum
kurals.m: The maiden, Earth, will laugh at the sight of those who plead poverty and lead an idle life
